request.query: Finite family Bezout identity in a Bezout ring

items.name: exists_gcd_eq_mul_add_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] [IsDomain R] [inst_3 : GCDMonoid R] (a b : R),
  ∃ x y, gcd a b = a * x + b * y

items.name: gcd_dvd_iff_exists
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] [IsDomain R] [inst_3 : GCDMonoid R] (a b : R) {z : R},
  gcd a b ∣ z ↔ ∃ x y, z = a * x + b * y

items.name: IsBezout.gcd_eq_sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] (x y : R) [inst_1 : Submodule.IsPrincipal (Ideal.span {x, y})],
  ∃ a b, a * x + b * y = IsBezout.gcd x y

items.name: IsBezout.nonemptyGCDMonoid
items.type: ∀ (R : Type u) [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] [IsDomain R], Nonempty (GCDMonoid R)
